title: A Polish Electroencephalography, Alzheimer’s Risk-genes, Lifestyle and Neuroimaging (PEARL-Neuro) Database
description: PEARL-Neuro is a multimodal database of healthy middle-aged (50-63 years) Polish adults at risk of dementia. It includes genetic data (APOE, PICALM) for 192 participants, along with demographic, health, lifestyle and psychometric measures. A subgroup of 79 participants also has EEG and fMRI recordings during resting-state (eyes open and eyes closed) and cognitive tasks (multi-source interference task, Sternberg memory task), plus blood test data.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG and fMRI were recorded with eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions, along with the multi-source interference task and Sternberg memory task. Participants were genotyped for APOE and PICALM, and completed psychometric assessments of memory, intelligence, mood, personality and stress coping. Blood tests were also collected.
